approaches.title: Compute push cost by groups of eight positions
approaches.summary: Calculates the total pushes by assigning increasing push counts to each consecutive block of eight characters. The revisions progress from block-wise iteration,

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses a while loop to process characters in groups of eight, adding the cost for each push-count tier.
Simplifies the same calculation by iterating over character positions and summing i / 8 + 1.
Replaces the per-character loop with a closed-form arithmetic sum over full blocks and the remainder.
